coverage.category: 1. Household employers: domestic workers, live-in carers, nannies
coverage.found: Nothing new beyond K05 (not searched again, per instruction not to re-check known ideas).

coverage.category: 2. Scrap-metal dealers
coverage.found: No Tunisian text found on a scrap-dealer register. Only the 17 Jan 2007 arrêté (JORT 7, 23 Jan 2007) with cahiers des charges for non-hazardous waste collection, transport, storage and recycling. ANGED is revising these cahiers des charges to favour SMEs. About 10,000 informal 'barbecha' collectors are to be formalised (state project, Jan 2025). Candidate C07 recorded as unverified.

coverage.category: 3. Second-hand dealers and pawnbrokers
coverage.found: Friperie (second-hand clothing) wholesalers must hold customs agrément and have their sales and purchase registers ratified by regional customs (since early 2024, La Presse). Candidate C02. Nothing found on pawnbrokers.

coverage.category: 4. Gold and jewellery buyers
coverage.found: Nothing new beyond K04 (not re-searched).

coverage.category: 5. Used car parts and vehicle dismantlers
coverage.found: No dismantler licensing rules found. ANGED has commissioned an end-of-life vehicle (VHU) management plan under PRONGIDD, which is still a study. Nothing to build on yet.

coverage.category: 6. Livestock traders, markets and animal transport
coverage.found: Nothing new beyond K14 (not re-searched). The OEP system covers identification.

coverage.category: 7. Small abattoirs and butchers
coverage.found: Only 19 of 158 active municipal abattoirs meet the conditions (about 11%); about 11 approved poultry abattoirs; OTIC (May 2026) calls for digital traceability. The buyers are mostly municipalities, and the state is the operator. Candidate C08 weak.

coverage.category: 8. Beekeepers
coverage.found: No beekeeper register or hive declaration found in Tunisia. About 12,000 beekeepers and 163,000 hives (APIA, undated). Only a voluntary APIA cahier des charges. Nothing to build on.

coverage.category: 9. Veterinary practices and veterinary medicine sellers
coverage.found: Nothing new. Law 78-23 (veterinary pharmacy) and Law 97-47 (veterinary profession) are the base texts. Since early 2024 veterinarians reportedly can only be supplied through the Pharmacie Centrale, which has two branches outside Tunis (webdo, Jan 2024). That is a supply problem, not a workflow one. No 2026 text found.

coverage.category: 10. Well drillers and water abstraction
coverage.found: Ministry announced (26 Mar 2026) an online platform for authorisations for wells deeper than 50 m (3,500-4,000 applications a year; not yet public, awaiting a security audit). Proposed law no. 18/2026 would regularise unauthorised deep wells drilled before 10 Dec 2024 for 3,500 TND, with files closed by 31 Dec 2027 (still a proposal). Candidate C04.

coverage.category: 11. Septic, sanitation and waste haulers
coverage.found: No Tunisian sources found (results were French, Quebec and Madagascar). Not confirmed either way.

coverage.category: 12. Lift, boiler and pressure-equipment owners and inspectors
coverage.found: Only found that Apave Tunisia is TUNAC-accredited (ISO 17020) for pressure vessels and lifts, and renewed in Nov 2022. No Tunisian decree text or periodicity found, so the duty on owners is unverified. Candidate C09 unverified.

coverage.category: 13. Small water systems
coverage.found: About 1,415-1,450 GDAs run rural drinking water (about 42% of rural supply); only about 35% are functional (MARHP 2023); they live only on water sales, with collection rates under 40% (webmanagercenter 2020). Governed by Law 99-43. Candidate C05.

coverage.category: 14. Pesticide and fertiliser dealers and applicators
coverage.found: Law 92-72 (art. 16-17) requires homologation and a ministerial agrément for any pesticide activity; decree 2010-2973; a cahier des charges applies to import, storage and sale. 31 active substances were withdrawn from 13 Jul 2023. No evidence of a dealer register or a new 2025-26 procedure. Candidate C06 unverified.

coverage.category: 15. Labour contractors and recruitment agencies
coverage.found: Law 2025 on work contracts and the ban on subcontracting (JORT 23 May 2025) is already K10. A new legal framework for private overseas recruitment bureaux was discussed (target May 2025), but publication is unconfirmed. Candidate C03 unverified.

coverage.category: 16. Cemeteries, burial societies and funeral services
coverage.found: The one search returned only French, Swiss and Belgian sources. No Tunisian source found and no budget left for a second attempt.

coverage.category: 17. Community and religious bodies: associations, charities, halal and kosher supervision
coverage.found: Decree-law 88/2011 art. 41 requires associations to publish foreign funding within one month and notify the government. In Feb 2025 the audit court (HCCAF head) said over 500 of 1,005 associations receiving foreign funding did not comply. A draft law on a digital associations platform exists but is unconfirmed. Political risk is high. Candidate C01. Halal supervision not searched.

coverage.category: 18. Transport operators: minibus, taxi, moto-taxi, small trucking and bus fleets
coverage.found: In Apr 2026 the transport minister announced a digital platform for professional cards and a legal framework for taxi apps. Reform of Law 2004-33 is overdue and a taxi/louage strike took place on 13 Jul 2026 over tariffs. No registers or recurring filing duty found. Candidate C10 weak.

coverage.category: 19. Market traders, street vendors, money changers
coverage.found: Money changers are K13 (not re-searched). Street vendors: only municipal enforcement against unauthorised friperie stalls (Sousse, Mar 2026). No recurring duty found.

coverage.category: 20. Small licensed premises with inspections: tattoo studios, driving schools, childminders and nurseries, small food producers, hunting outfitters
coverage.found: Nurseries/crèches and small food producers screened (candidates C11 and C12). Driving schools search returned only French and Moroccan material, nothing Tunisian. Tattoo studios and hunting outfitters not searched (budget).

coverage.category: 31. NACEF fiscal cash registers for cafes, restaurants, fast food, bakeries with seating (arrete 14 Oct 2025)
coverage.found: Phase 1 1 Nov 2025 (legal entities: tourist restaurants, tea rooms, cat. 2-3 cafes); 1 Jul 2026 all legal entities selling prepared food/drink on site; 1 Jul 2027 individuals on the real regime filing monthly; 1 Jul 2028 other individuals. Penalties under art. 94 CDPF: 16 days to 3 years prison, 1,000-50,000 TND. Registers must be from suppliers approved on Jibaya.tn (homologation.nacef.tn), online enrolment, real-time transmission. Candidate logged.

coverage.category: 32. Auto-entrepreneur regime (revenue ceiling 75,000 TND; national register, Moubader platform)
coverage.found: Launched Nov 2024; about 8,800 registered by Apr 2026; declaration and payment platform from 15 Apr 2026; ramp-up from Jul 2026 when the first-year exemption ends; reporting reportedly quarterly (2020 BDO note; current rule unconfirmed). Banks slow to open accounts. State platform handles declaration, so only an assisted layer is possible. Candidate logged.

coverage.category: 33. Alternative tourist lodging licensing reform (2025-2026 cahiers des charges)
coverage.found: See category 29; treated together. Reform replaces licences with cahiers des charges, six lodging types; delays flagged in 2026 budget debate.

coverage.category: 34. Decennial insurance and public-works compliance (circular no. 6, Sep 2026)
coverage.found: Enforcement of an existing 1994 duty on public sites; no new duty for private contractors found.

coverage.category: 35. Olive-oil mills, packers and exporters (ONH, Conseil de l'huile conditionnee)
coverage.found: No ONH or customs register or report rule found; market data only. Nothing actionable.

coverage.category: 36. Narcotics law 52-1992 revision / pharmacy dispensing records
coverage.found: Draft only (May 2026 hearings); merged into category 25 candidate.

coverage.category: 37. Furnished short-term rental platform bill (15 MPs, 2025)
coverage.found: Bill filed; no adoption found. Merged into category 29 candidate.
